Package com.ibm.websphere.dynamic.routing

@Version("1.2") package com.ibm.websphere.dynamic.routing
This package contains all of the public APIs (exposed as MBeans) which are primarily around the DynamicRouting-1.0 liberty feature. Functionality around the DynamicRouting feature can be found in the com.ibm.websphere.dynamic.routing package.
